subject: biologie
limitations: Supported rows prepare practical, observational, oral or social competence; the activity still takes place in class.
All written answers use explicit self-assessment, not automated content grading.
The four visual models are qualitative classroom simplifications, not biological measurements or personal health advice.
Teacher review and teacher videos remain open. The package is published as a preview, with its status visibly marked in the app and Academy.
